summary_en: ¥500M upper limit. 1,000,000 shares (17.6% of 5.67M ex-treasury S/O). Open-market acquisition on Tokyo Stock Exchange. Period: Aug 14, 2026–Aug 13, 2027. Price ceiling not disclosed.
title_en: Notice on Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: JSH Co., Ltd. announced on August 13, 2026, that its board of directors has approved the acquisition of treasury shares under Article 156 of the Companies Act (as applied by Article 165(3)). The acquisition targets up to 1,000,000 ordinary shares of the company—17.6% of the 5,666,100 shares outstanding excluding existing treasury—with a maximum expenditure of ¥500 million. The shares will be acquired via open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange over a 12-month period from August 14, 2026, to August 13, 2027. No price ceiling per share is disclosed. The stated rationale is to enhance shareholder returns, improve capital efficiency, and enable flexible capital-allocation decisions in response to future business conditions. As of the announcement date, the company held no treasury shares.
